categoryDescriptions.Yazılım: Programming languages, web and backend development, data structures and algorithms. Project-based, hands-on software courses for everyone from beginners to professional developers.
categoryDescriptions.Sosyal Bilimler: History, the history of the Republic and the social sciences. Courses that read events through their sources and their causes, building critical thinking and interpretation.
categoryDescriptions.Fen Bilimleri: Physics, chemistry, biology and astronomy. Science courses at high-school and university-prep level that explain nature through experiment, observation and modelling.
categoryDescriptions.Yabancı Dil: Levelled language courses from A1 to B2, mainly English and German. Listening, speaking, reading and writing, practised through everyday and workplace situations.
categoryDescriptions.Sanat: Pencil drawing, sketching, colour theory and art history. Studio lessons that train observation and the hand, and teach you to read artworks in their period and context.
categoryDescriptions.Müzik: Piano, guitar and basic music theory. Levelled instrument lessons, from reading notes to rhythm and harmony, from your first piece to playing on stage.
categoryDescriptions.Spor: Physical education, functional training and healthy living. Programmes that teach good technique, injury prevention and a training habit you can keep.
categoryDescriptions.Tasarım: UI/UX, graphic design and typography. Design courses for digital and print, from user research and prototyping to visual hierarchy and brand identity.
categoryDescriptions.Genel: Effective study techniques, time management and general knowledge. Cross-subject skills that support learning in every field.
categoryDescriptions.Matematik: From basic maths to calculus, geometry and discrete mathematics. Lessons that build intuition first, then reinforce it with proofs and plenty of practice, preparing you for exams and engineering.
categoryDescriptions.Coğrafya: Physical geography, geomorphology, climatology, the geography of Türkiye, map reading and Geographic Information Systems (GIS). Lessons on the processes that shape the Earth and on thinking spatially.
categoryDescriptions.Veri Bilimi & Yapay Zeka: Data analysis, statistical modelling, machine learning and deep learning. Hands-on courses that take you from cleaning data in Python to building models and reading their results honestly.
categoryDescriptions.Ekonomi & Finans: Micro and macroeconomics, monetary policy, accounting and personal finance. Courses that teach you to read markets, financial statements and economic news with confidence.
categoryDescriptions.Edebiyat & Felsefe: Turkish and world literature, the big questions of philosophy, logic and critical thinking. Courses on close reading, building an argument and writing your own interpretation.
categoryDescriptions.Fotoğrafçılık & Sinema: Digital photography, film language, film analysis and short film making. Workshops on telling stories with images by understanding light, framing and editing.
categoryDescriptions.Türk Dili ve Edebiyatı: Turkish grammar, paragraph and reading comprehension, text analysis, academic composition, Republic-era literature, and Ottoman Turkish paleography. Courses that develop native language awareness, effective written and oral communication, and literary heritage in academic depth.
categoryDescriptions.Psikoloji & Bilişsel Bilimler: Developmental psychology, cognitive models, philosophy of mind, social psychology, experimental designs, and behavioral research methods. Courses exploring human behavior, thinking processes, and the biological and computational foundations of the mind using scientific methods.
categoryDescriptions.Hukuk & Kamu Yönetimi: Constitutional and administrative law, contract and commercial law, IT and data-protection law. Courses that read every rule with its rationale, reinforce it by solving concrete cases and explain how public administration works.
categoryDescriptions.Mühendislik & Robotik: Embedded systems, electronics, robotics, control systems and mechanical design with CAD. Project-based engineering workshops where you build and code the circuit, then draw and make the mechanism.

descriptions.İleri Seviye C# ve .NET API: Advanced C# features and building tested, documented REST APIs with ASP.NET Core.
descriptions.Java: Object-oriented programming in Java: classes, inheritance, collections and Streams.
descriptions.Veri Yapıları: Arrays, lists, trees, hash tables and graphs, with their time and memory costs.
descriptions.Algoritmalar: Systematic problem solving with sorting, divide and conquer, dynamic programming and graph algorithms.
descriptions.React ile Modern Web Geliştirme: Fast, accessible interfaces with React 19 and TypeScript, ending in a capstone project.
descriptions.Matematik: Numbers, equations, functions and logarithms: a solid base for exam preparation.
descriptions.Matematik Geometri: Comprehensive geometry, from triangles and circles to solids and analytic geometry.
descriptions.Ayrık Matematik: Logic, proof, combinatorics and graph theory: the mathematical foundation of computer science.
descriptions.Fizik: Mechanics, energy, electricity and optics, learned by building models rather than memorising formulas.
descriptions.Kimya: Core chemistry, from atoms and reactions to acids, bases and organic chemistry.
descriptions.Biyoloji: From the cell to the ecosystem: genetics, human physiology and ecology.
descriptions.Astronomiye Giriş: Constellations, the Solar System, the lives of stars and observing practice.
descriptions.Fiziki Coğrafya: The Earth's motions, climate, the water cycle, soils and vegetation.
descriptions.Jeomorfoloji: Landforms shaped by internal and external forces, with field examples from Türkiye.
descriptions.Türkiye Coğrafyası: Türkiye's location, landforms, climate, population and economy, region by region.
descriptions.Harita Bilgisi ve CBS: Scale, projections, reading contour lines and spatial analysis with QGIS.
descriptions.Coğrafya: A general introduction to physical, human and economic geography.
descriptions.Tarih: From the first civilisations to the Ottomans and the modern age, read through the sources.
descriptions.Cumhuriyet Tarihi: The founding and growth of the Republic of Türkiye, from the War of Independence to multi-party politics.
descriptions.İngilizce: Fluent speaking, reading and writing for learners aiming at B1-B2.
descriptions.Almanca A1: Pronunciation, articles and everyday phrases, preparing for Goethe A1.
descriptions.UI/UX Tasarımın Temelleri: End-to-end product design, from user research to a Figma prototype.
descriptions.Grafik Tasarım ve Tipografi: Composition, colour and type, with a brand-identity project.
descriptions.Karakalem ve Desen: Proportion, perspective, light and shadow, and figure drawing.
descriptions.Sanat Tarihine Giriş: From cave paintings to contemporary art, reading works in their context.
descriptions.Piyano Eğitimi: Piano for every level, from reading notes to playing with both hands.
descriptions.Gitar Eğitimi: Chords, strumming patterns, reading tabs and simple solos.
descriptions.Beden Eğitimi: Warm-ups, basic motor skills, team sports and healthy living.
descriptions.Fonksiyonel Antrenman: Fundamental movement patterns and a weekly plan for your level.
descriptions.Etkili Çalışma Teknikleri: Spaced repetition, self-testing, time management and exam anxiety.
descriptions.Topluluk Önünde Konuşma: Manage stage fright, structure your ideas and hold an audience, with a recorded talk and feedback in every lesson.
descriptions.Temel Matematik: A solid restart in numbers, fractions, ratios, percentages and first steps in algebra, built on everyday examples.
descriptions.Kalkülüs ve Analiz: Limits, derivatives, integrals and series, built on intuition first and then on systematic technique.
descriptions.Lineer Cebir: Vectors, matrices, linear maps and eigenvalues, each with a geometric picture and real applications.
descriptions.Olasılık ve İstatistik: From counting and distributions to confidence intervals and hypothesis tests, with real data and simulations.
descriptions.Python: Learn to program with Python: variables, control flow, functions, data structures, files and a small automation project.
descriptions.SQL ve Veritabanı Tasarımı: Design relational schemas and query them with SQL: joins, grouping, window functions, indexes and transactions.
descriptions.Python ile Veri Analizi: Clean, reshape and visualise real data with NumPy, pandas and seaborn, ending in an analysis report.
descriptions.Makine Öğrenmesine Giriş: Regression, classification, trees, clustering and model evaluation with scikit-learn, maths and code side by side.
descriptions.Derin Öğrenme ve Sinir Ağları: Build neural networks from scratch, then train CNNs and Transformer models with PyTorch.
descriptions.Veri Görselleştirme ve Hikâye Anlatımı: Turn numbers into honest, persuasive charts and dashboards using perception, colour and narrative.
descriptions.Mikroekonomiye Giriş: Supply and demand, elasticity, firm decisions, market structures and market failures, with current examples.
descriptions.Makroekonomi ve Para Politikası: Growth, inflation, interest rates, central banking and exchange rates, read through current data.
descriptions.Kişisel Finans ve Yatırım: Budgeting, debt, compound interest and the logic of savings and investment products. Financial literacy, not investment advice.
descriptions.Muhasebenin Temelleri: Double-entry bookkeeping, journals, the income statement and balance sheet, and ratio analysis for a small business.
descriptions.Türk Edebiyatına Giriş: From Divan poetry to the Republican novel, the main periods of Turkish literature read through key texts.
descriptions.Felsefeye Giriş: Knowledge, mind, ethics, politics and art: philosophy's big questions through short readings and careful argument.
descriptions.Mantık ve Eleştirel Düşünme: Tell strong arguments from weak ones: propositional logic, induction, fallacies, cognitive biases and source checking.
descriptions.Dijital Fotoğrafçılığın Temelleri: Leave auto mode behind: exposure, focus, light, composition and basic editing, with a shooting assignment each week.
descriptions.Sinema Dili ve Film Analizi: Framing, camera movement, mise-en-scène, editing and sound, analysed scene by scene.
descriptions.Kısa Film Yapımı: Write, shoot, record, edit and grade your own 3 to 5 minute short film.
descriptions.Sosyolojiye Giriş: Culture, inequality, cities and migration, and how sociologists study them.
descriptions.İspanyolca A1: A communicative start in Spanish: pronunciation, ser and estar, regular verbs and everyday conversations.
descriptions.Müzik Teorisi ve Kulak Eğitimi: Notation, rhythm, intervals, scales, chords and harmony, with ear training in every lesson.
descriptions.Suluboya Atölyesi: Control water and pigment: washes, wet-on-wet, colour mixing and preserving the white of the paper.
descriptions.Yoga ve Mobilite: Flows and mobility routines for every level to undo long days at a desk, no equipment needed.
descriptions.TYT-AYT Türkçe Paragraf ve Anlam Bilgisi: Designed for YKS candidates, this intermediate and advanced course equips students with the skills to solve paragraph questions accurately and quickly under time pressure. Main ideas, supporting details, narrative techniques, and paragraph structure analysis are covered in depth. It targets high school seniors and graduates who want to ensure time management in the exam and eliminate distractor options quickly.
descriptions.Türkçe Dil Bilgisi ve Yazım Kuralları: Designed for students preparing for LGS and TYT exams, this beginner and intermediate course systematically covers parts of speech, affixes, sentence elements, and current TDK spelling rules. Participants overcome habitual errors in grammar questions and apply rules directly to text. It is for all students aiming for full marks on exams and seeking to establish a complete foundation in Turkish.
descriptions.Akademik Türkçe ve Kompozisyon: Prepared for university students and researchers engaged in thesis writing, this intermediate course examines academic language conventions, text structure, and composition development. Participants can build the argumentative framework of an academic article or essay, cite sources avoiding plagiarism, and produce fluent texts. It is aimed at all undergraduate and graduate students who want to master scientific writing.
descriptions.Cumhuriyet Dönemi Türk Edebiyatı: Designed for faculty of literature students and literature enthusiasts, this advanced course analyzes the transformation of Turkish literature from 1923 to the present. Participants understand the theoretical foundations of movements such as Garip, the Second New, and Socialist Realism, and analyze leading novels and poems of the period through literary theories. It addresses researchers seeking an in-depth study of Turkish literary modernization.
descriptions.Osmanlı Türkçesi ve Metin Okumaları: Prepared for history and literature researchers, this advanced course teaches the reading of printed and manuscript texts written in Ottoman Turkish. Participants learn grammatical rules of Arabic and Persian origin, distinguish Rika and Naskh scripts, and independently decipher archival documents. It is intended for researchers aiming to read historical sources directly from original texts.
descriptions.Diksiyon ve Etkili Hitabet: Designed for professionals and students speaking in public, this intermediate applied workshop covers proper vocal usage and the art of rhetoric. Participants learn to breathe with proper diaphragmatic support, apply Turkish phonetics and stress rules, and deliver persuasive presentations by managing anxiety. It is aimed at anyone seeking to strengthen communication skills and present themselves with confidence.
descriptions.Psikolojiye Giriş: Prepared for those interested in psychological science, this beginner course examines the fundamental theories of human behavior and mental processes. Participants grasp major schools of psychology ranging from biological bases to learning, memory, and social psychology, evaluating human behavior within a scientific framework. It is suitable for anyone curious about understanding the mechanics of the mind through core concepts.
descriptions.Gelişim Psikolojisi: Developed for educators and psychology students, this intermediate course examines the cognitive, emotional, and social development of individuals from birth to adulthood. Participants can analyze models from pioneering theorists like Piaget, Vygotsky, and Erikson, interpreting key developmental milestones through case studies. It is designed for those seeking an in-depth understanding of the stages of human development.
descriptions.Bilişsel Bilime Giriş: Prepared for those working in artificial intelligence, computing, and psychology, this intermediate course approaches the information processing mechanisms of the mind from an interdisciplinary perspective. Participants can construct mental models at the intersection of neuroscience, AI, and cognitive psychology, explaining perception and thought processes through computational methods. It is intended for those wanting to investigate the mind comprehensively.
descriptions.Araştırma Yöntemleri ve Deney Tasarımı: Prepared for researchers writing theses or articles in behavioral and cognitive sciences, this advanced course covers experimental methodology and data analysis. Participants can formulate testable hypotheses, design laboratory experiments controlling confounding variables, and analyze collected data using appropriate statistical tests. It is aimed at graduate students seeking to conduct independent scientific research.
descriptions.YKS Tarih Soru Kampı: Prepared for YKS candidates, this intermediate question-solving camp covers TYT and AYT History topics using chronological tests and concept maps. Participants gain skills to quickly analyze premise-based and map-based history questions, establish historical cause-and-effect relationships, and eliminate distractors. It is intended for high school seniors aiming to fill knowledge gaps and increase problem-solving practice before the exam.
descriptions.Kent Sosyolojisi ve Saha Araştırması: Prepared for sociology and urban planning students, this advanced applied course explores theories of urban transformation, migration, and spatial segregation. Participants can apply qualitative research techniques in urban spaces, theoretically interpreting data from in-depth interviews and participant observation. It is directed toward researchers aiming to investigate urban dynamics directly in the field.
descriptions.Figma ile Prototipleme Atölyesi: Prepared for digital product designers and UI developers, this advanced applied workshop produces complex interactive prototypes in Figma. Participants can build prototypes delivering real app experiences using variables, smart animations, and component sets, preparing them for user testing. It is aimed at designers wishing to add strong portfolio projects.
descriptions.Marka Kimliği ve Logo Tasarımı: Created for graphic designers and agency professionals, this intermediate course covers the steps of designing a visual brand identity from scratch. Participants can manage the complete design workflow from brief analysis and logo sketching to color palette and typography selection, delivering a brand guideline to clients. It is for designers aiming to produce work meeting professional branding standards.
descriptions.Rönesans'tan Modernizme Sanat Tarihi: Prepared for art and architecture students and cultural enthusiasts, this advanced course examines the evolution of Western art from the 14th century to the 20th century. Participants understand the philosophical background of Renaissance, Baroque, Romanticism, and Modernism movements, analyzing period works through iconographic and formal methods. It is aimed at those seeking an academic appreciation of visual art history.
descriptions.Armoni ve Beste Atölyesi: Prepared for musicians and producers, this advanced course practically explores the rules of tonal and modal harmony. Participants can construct chord progressions, apply voice leading principles, and compose their own melodies with rich harmonic layers. It is intended for musicians who grasp basic music theory and want to arrange their original compositions at professional standards.
descriptions.Sporcu Beslenmesi ve Performans: Designed for active athletes and coaches, this intermediate course explores nutrition strategies that optimize workout efficiency and recovery. Participants can calculate macro- and micronutrient requirements specific to their sports, build pre- and post-competition nutrition protocols, and scientifically evaluate ergogenic aids. It is intended for those seeking to enhance physical performance through nutrition.
descriptions.YKS ve LGS Sınav Stratejileri: Designed for students preparing for centralized examinations and their parents, this guidance-oriented beginner and intermediate course covers study methodology. Participants can prepare personalized study schedules, identify knowledge gaps through mock exam analysis, and apply exam anxiety management techniques. It is suitable for all candidates seeking to run their YKS or LGS preparation effectively and systematically.
descriptions.Hızlı Okuma ve Not Alma Teknikleri: Designed for students and professionals engaged in heavy reading, this beginner course covers techniques that increase reading speed and comprehension rates. Participants can reduce subvocalization by training eye muscles, apply structured note-taking systems like Cornell, and summarize information permanently. It is suited for anyone wanting to multiply reading efficiency and save time.
descriptions.Dünya Edebiyatından Klasikler: Prepared for literature lovers and university students, this intermediate course analyzes essential masterpieces of Eastern and Western classics from philosophical and literary viewpoints. Participants dissect core motifs in works by authors like Dostoevsky, Goethe, and Kafka, comparatively evaluating narrative techniques reflecting the human condition. It is directed toward readers seeking to explore deeper layers of classic texts.
descriptions.Mobil Fotoğrafçılık ve Video Kurgu: Prepared for social media content creators and visual arts enthusiasts, this beginner applied course covers shooting and editing with smartphones. Participants learn to utilize natural lighting, apply composition principles, and edit professional videos using mobile editing applications. It is for anyone looking to transform their smartphone into a creative production tool.
descriptions.Genetik ve Moleküler Biyoloji: Formulated for biology, medicine, and bioengineering students, this advanced course covers the molecular mechanisms and genetic regulation of the cell in detail. Participants can analyze DNA replication, gene expression, epigenetic modifications, and modern gene-editing techniques like CRISPR in theoretical and experimental dimensions. It is aimed at researchers seeking a solid foundation in molecular life sciences.
descriptions.LGS Fen Bilimleri Kampı: Designed for 8th-grade students preparing for the LGS examination, this intermediate question camp reviews all science units in the national curriculum using new-generation questions. Participants gain skills in interpreting graphs and tables, solving experiment-based questions, and managing time under control. It is aimed at final-year middle school students targeting higher scores and full marks in science.
descriptions.Jeopolitik ve Beşeri Coğrafya: Prepared for international relations, geography, and public administration students, this intermediate course examines the interaction between global balance of power and human dynamics. Participants can spatially analyze demographic movements, energy corridors, border disputes, and climate migration across maps. It is suitable for all researchers wishing to interpret world politics through geographic realities.
descriptions.Anayasa Hukukuna Giriş: Learn the basic structure of the state, fundamental rights and freedoms, and constitutional review from scratch. We cover everything from the concept of a constitution to the legislative, executive and judicial branches, from individual applications to the Constitutional Court to electoral systems, with current rulings. For law-school candidates, future civil servants and anyone who wants to deepen their civic knowledge.
descriptions.İdare Hukuku ve Kamu Yönetimi: Learn how the administration is organised, which rules govern its acts and which remedies exist against them. Central and local government, administrative acts and contracts, public servants and the administrative court system are explained through real rulings. Suited to candidates preparing for public-administration and civil-service exams.
descriptions.Borçlar ve Ticaret Hukukunun Temelleri: Learn the legal foundations of everyday and commercial life, from making a contract to running a company. Sources of obligations, formation and performance of contracts, tort liability, the merchant, company types and negotiable instruments are covered through concrete cases. For entrepreneurs, business and economics students and newcomers to law.
descriptions.KVKK ve Bilişim Hukuku: Learn to process data lawfully in the digital world. Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK), privacy notices and explicit consent, breach notification, comparison with the GDPR, cybercrime and e-commerce regulation are explained with practical examples. Suited to developers, product managers, compliance and legal teams.
descriptions.Arduino ile Gömülü Sistemlere Giriş: Learn microcontroller programming from scratch with Arduino. Digital and analog I/O, reading sensors, driving motors, interrupts and serial communication are covered by building a working circuit in every lesson. For students new to electronics and coding, and anyone who wants to build their own smart device.
descriptions.Temel Elektronik ve Devre Analizi: Learn the basic laws of electronics and how to solve circuits. Ohm's and Kirchhoff's laws, nodal and mesh analysis, capacitors and inductors, diode and transistor circuits are built and measured on a breadboard. For engineering students and anyone who wants a solid start in embedded systems.
descriptions.ROS ile Robotik ve Kontrol Sistemleri: Learn how an autonomous mobile robot senses, decides and moves. Robot kinematics, PID control, ROS 2 nodes and topics, sensor fusion and SLAM mapping are built step by step in simulation. For engineering students who know Python or C++ and want to specialise in control and robotics.
descriptions.SolidWorks ile CAD ve Mekanik Tasarım: Learn to take a part from sketch to production-ready design. Sketches and constraints, solid modelling, assemblies, technical drawings, tolerances and basic strength analysis are covered through the design of a real robot arm. Suited to mechanical and mechatronics students, product developers and anyone prototyping with a 3D printer.
descriptions.Siber Güvenlik ve Ağ Temelleri: Build your defences by learning how networks work and how they are attacked. TCP/IP, DNS and HTTP, firewalls, encryption, the OWASP Top 10 and basic penetration-testing tools are practised in a lab environment. For career changers moving into cybersecurity and developers who want to write secure code.
descriptions.Flutter ile Mobil Uygulama Geliştirme: Learn to build Android and iOS apps from a single codebase. The Dart language, the widget tree, state management, fetching data from a REST API, local storage and store publishing are taught through a shopping app built end to end. For those who know basic programming and want to ship their first mobile app.
descriptions.Docker, Kubernetes ve DevOps: Learn to containerise applications and deploy them to the cloud automatically. Docker images, Compose, Kubernetes objects, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and monitoring are covered by shipping a real web service. For backend developers and anyone moving into DevOps engineering.
descriptions.Unity ile Oyun Geliştirme: Design and publish your first game with Unity and C#. Scene layout, the physics engine, character control, animation, UI and audio are taught through a 2D platformer built from start to finish. For anyone curious about game development with basic programming knowledge.
descriptions.Büyük Veri ve Veri Mühendisliği: Learn to build data pipelines that collect, transform and prepare millions of rows for analysis. Data-warehouse modelling, distributed processing with Apache Spark, streaming with Kafka, workflow orchestration with Airflow and data-quality checks are practised hands-on. For those who know SQL and Python and want to become data engineers.
descriptions.Siyaset Bilimi ve Uluslararası İlişkiler: Learn how the state, power, democracy and the international system work, starting from the basic concepts. Political ideologies, electoral and party systems, theories of international relations such as realism and liberalism, and institutions like the UN and the EU are covered with current examples. For future political science and IR students and anyone who wants to read current affairs in depth.
descriptions.Hukukun Temel Kavramları ve Anayasa Bilg: Learn the legal rules you meet in everyday life and your rights as a citizen in plain language. The sources of law, rights and legal capacity, the court system and the turning points of Turkish constitutional history are explained with case examples. Suited to high-school and university students, civil-service exam candidates and anyone taking a first step into law.
descriptions.Etik ve Estetiğe Giriş: What makes an action good and a work beautiful? You will discuss moral theories such as virtue ethics, deontology and utilitarianism through current dilemmas, and learn to judge works of art with aesthetic approaches from Plato and Kant to contemporary thinkers. For anyone interested in philosophy who wants to sharpen their arguing and writing.
descriptions.Girişimcilik ve İş Stratejisi: Learn to turn a business idea into a validated business model. Customer discovery, the business model canvas, competitive analysis, unit economics, pricing and the investor pitch are applied step by step to your own idea. For aspiring founders, startup team members and students interested in corporate strategy.
descriptions.IELTS ve Akademik İngilizce: Prepare systematically for the IELTS Academic exam for study and job applications abroad. The format of all four skills, the band descriptors, Writing Task 1 and 2 structures, academic reading strategies and speaking mock tests are practised with one-to-one feedback. For learners at B2 level who want to reach their target band.
descriptions.Blender ile 3B Modelleme ve Animasyon: Learn 3D modelling, materials, lighting and animation from scratch with free, open-source Blender. From simple objects to product visualisation, from camera moves to a short motion-graphics scene, you finish a piece of work in every lesson. For designers, game and video creators and anyone stepping into 3D.
descriptions.Seramik ve Heykel Atölyesi: Get to know the language of clay and three-dimensional form. Hand-building methods, an introduction to the potter's wheel, proportional figure sculpture, glazing and firing are practised in small studio groups. You leave with a functional object of your own design and a small sculpture. No previous experience needed.
descriptions.Ableton ile Müzik Prodüksiyonu: Go from an idea to a finished track on your computer. With Ableton Live you learn to write beats and harmony, design sounds with a synthesiser, and handle sampling, arrangement, mixing and mastering on your own track. For musicians with basic music knowledge and content creators who want to produce their own music.
descriptions.Hareket Bilimi ve Sakatlıktan Korunma: Train more safely and efficiently by understanding how your body moves. Basic anatomy and biomechanics, movement analysis, the causes of common sports injuries, warm-ups and preventive exercise programmes are practised hands-on. For regular exercisers, aspiring coaches and anyone returning to sport safely after an injury.
descriptions.Araştırma Yöntemleri ve Bilimsel Etik: Learn the steps of scientific work, from framing a research question to reporting findings honestly. Literature review, quantitative and qualitative methods, sampling, data-collection tools, citation, plagiarism and research ethics boards are explained through sample projects. For students preparing assignments, projects, theses or research grant proposals.

help.title: Help
help.heroSubtitle: The most common questions about enrolling, the wallet and refunds, lesson progress, badges and instructor applications are below. If the answer is not there, write to the support team and follow your request on My Support Requests.
help.faqDesc: Up-to-date answers that match how the platform works today.

questions.q1: How do I enrol in a course and pay for it?
questions.a1: Open a course from the Courses page. Free courses are one click away. Paid courses are bought with your wallet balance: top up on the Wallet page, then press the buy button on the course page. The price leaves your balance and the course is added to My Courses right away.
questions.q2: Can I get a refund for a course I bought?
questions.a2: Yes. Within 7 days of buying, the "Refund" link on the course page returns the full price to your wallet and closes your access to the course. After 7 days a refund is no longer possible.
questions.q3: How are my course progress and badges calculated?
questions.a3: You finish a lesson with the "Mark Complete" button on the course page or by watching its video to the end. The course progress bar shows the share of finished lessons (0-100%); once every lesson is done the course moves to "Completed Courses". Completed courses and lessons unlock the badges on your profile: your first graduation, a specialism in one field, courses across different fields and your total lesson count.
questions.q4: How do I apply to become an instructor?
questions.a4: Choose the instructor role when you sign up, pick your discipline from the list and write a short biography. With an invite code from an admin your account becomes an instructor right away; without one your application goes to admin approval and, once approved, you sign in as an instructor next time.
questions.q5: How do I change my username, email or password?
questions.a5: Use the Account tab on the Settings page to update your username, email and password. Changing the password needs your current one, and after changing your username you are asked to sign in again. You can also delete your account from the same tab.

about.title: Learn it from *someone* who does it.
about.mission: E-Kurs is a course platform built around one idea: the best person to teach a subject is someone who practises it. Our instructors are engineers, researchers, artists and teachers who bring their daily work into every lesson.
about.mission2: Every course is a sequence of short video lessons with a public syllabus, so you know exactly what you will learn before you spend anything.
about.approachDesc: Four principles shape every course on the platform.

practice.title: Practitioners first
practice.desc: Instructors teach from what they do: real projects, real data, real field notes. Concepts arrive with the problem they solve.
